pr_title: fix(es/transform/resolver): avoid ident collapse for the reexport
pr_body:
<!-- Thanks for submitting a pull request! Please provide enough information so that others can review your pull request. -->

**Description:**

Attempts to close #3114. 

This PR applies new mark to named export if

- named export comes from direct reexport (`export { some } from 'xxx'`)
- and export's ident collapses to existing ident

In case of #3114, existing logic treat reexported ident is same as imported one via `import type {...}`, ends up stripping its existence. However, if named export comes from direct reexport it is ensured it won't come from any ident in existing scope. PR attempts to assign new context for those cases.

Disclaimer this may not be the correct approach and I may did wrong.

**Related issue (if exists):**
- closes #3114
pr_comments:
> Is this not possible from typescript::strip?

It is original place I started, I think it'll work if we try to ignore strip for the specific ident collapses. The reason I choose to update parser was to have a proper context for the ident _maybe_ useful to other transforms as it'll be guaranteed to be treated as different ident.

I'll give it another go and update PR if it works.

Oh, I see.
We apply resolver right after parsing, so it can be the place IMO.
Cool, I'll try to peek resolver as well.

> Does this also fix #2924?

doesn't look like so. It seems like there's some other offender in mangle side, or my changes are not suffecient to deal with all cases. If this goes in, I'll try to peek mangle side if there's an easy fix.
